And that was when my friend, James told me about the FishEye Panaromic 360 degree Cam.

Introducing ...

See the entire place on your mobile phone anywhere, anyday

Thousands of Ghanians are now using this device to monitor and keep an eye on their children at home, workers in the office, patients in the hospital, customers in the shop, etc and to regulate movements around the building using the voice insta-call function.


Now, these are what the Panaromic Cam will do for you: (features)

  • The camera is equipped with an AP hotspot to send out WIFI signal, phone and tablet can connect to WIFI to watch what is going on without network.
  • If any abnormal movement is detected, the abnormal screen will be pushed to the mobile phone APP and a notification sent to you, so as to check the situation at home/office/store at any time.
  • Intelligent high definition camera, built-in microphone and speaker, support two-way voice intercom, let you talk to your family anytime and anywhere.
  • Activate Alarm to scare any stranger in your home/office/store/school etc.
  • Support multiple platforms remote monitoring, while supporting multiple devices to watch.Support Android, IOS, Windows, mobile phone, tablet and computer remote viewing.
  • Support mobile phone remote real-time monitoring, card storage, video playback.
  • You can manage up to 30 cameras in one app
